variants.headline: Party divides in two
variants.body: The party {party} has split, with {splinter} the new breakaway party. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: A political organisation breaks apart
variants.body: A split in {party} has produced the new party {splinter}. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: Unity gives way to a party split
variants.body: The new party {splinter} has broken away from {party}. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.
